flows.title: Import contacts from a file
steps: Click Audience, click the Add contacts drop-down, choose Import contacts, click Upload a file, then click Continue.
Click Select a file to choose your import file, or drag and drop it in, then click Continue and confirm the audience to import into.
Click Continue to tag, choose or create tags for the imported contacts if you want, then continue through matching your file's columns to Mailchimp fields.
Use the marketing status drop-downs to choose Subscribed, Unsubscribed, or Non-subscribed for the imported contacts.
Click Finalize import to review your settings, then click Complete Import.

flows.title: Create a tag
steps: If you have more than one audience, click the Audience drop-down and choose the one you want to work with.
Enter the tag name, then click Create.

flows.title: Create a regular email campaign
steps: From the homepage, click Create email, then click the X icon on the design popup to go straight to the email checklist.
In the To section, click the Audience drop-down, choose the audience to send to, then click Save.
In the From section, enter the name and email address recipients will see, and click Save. In the Subject section, enter a subject line and optional preview text, and click Save.
In the Send time section, click Schedule to pick a time in the future or Send now to send immediately, then click Save.
Design the email in the Content section. A checkmark appears beside each required section once it is done.
